findings.title: LD clause lacks express sole remedy statement
findings.deviation: Section 10.1 sets liquidated damages at 0.5% per week up to a 5% milestone cap for Provider-caused delay, but does not explicitly state that LDs are Provider's sole and exclusive remedy for delay.
findings.impact: Greystone could attempt to seek additional damages for delay beyond the agreed liquidated damages cap.
findings.quote: Liquidated damages of 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week of Provider-caused delay, capped at 5% of that milestone fee; not applicable to delays caused by Greystone or force majeure.
findings.counterPosition: Add language clarifying that liquidated damages are the sole and exclusive remedy for delay.

findings.title: Professional liability insurance limit requires confirmation
findings.deviation: Section 12.2 mandates $1,000,000 in professional liability insurance, which is not currently recorded in AtliQ's internal register.
findings.impact: AtliQ may not meet contract requirements upon signing if its existing policy coverage falls short of $1,000,000.
findings.quote: Provider shall maintain professional liability and cyber liability insurance of $1,000,000 each.
findings.counterPosition: Verify internal policy limits for professional liability prior to signing, or adjust the contractual requirement to reflect existing coverage.

fine.note: Payment terms of 30 days align with AtliQ's standard.
Liability cap of 1x 12-month fees with standard carve-outs matches AtliQ standard.
Mutual indemnity for third-party claims resulting from confidentiality non-compliance, IP infringement, or gross negligence/willful misconduct matches standard.
Client owns specific deliverables upon payment while AtliQ retains background IP and grants a licence, matching standard.
Delaware governing law and forum align with standard for AtliQ Inc.
30 days' notice for convenience termination with payment for work performed and non-cancellable commitments matches standard.
Mutual confidentiality with 3-year general survival and indefinite protection for trade secrets and personal data matches standard.
Mutual 12-month non-solicitation of personnel engaged in services complies with standard.
Data security terms including GLBA compliance and restricted offshore VDI access meet AtliQ standard.
90-day warranty following acceptance aligns with standard.
